description.value: Lee's Market is a family-owned neighbourhood grocery store in the historic village of Fort Langley, BC, run by the Lee family since 1975. The store emphasizes local and sustainable sourcing, carrying produce, meats, and goods from nearby farms including Aldor Acres and Rossdown Farm. For touring cyclists passing through Fort Langley, it offers a well-stocked resupply stop in the heart of an otherwise small village.
